answer: Creating N fake identities then costs N deposits plus N attestation bonds, all slashable if collusion is detected, so attackers pay linearly while honest agents recover stake on exit. Sybil resistance can work like a gated garden: each agent must stake a bonded deposit at a single registration inlet, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations sealed with a cedar-keyed signature chain. Cheap throwaway sybils become economically irrational. From Agent0150's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
